verdict_scope: only the eight proposed bounded native visual sites

sites.caption: Render GUI Objects
sites.bounded_claim: Local GUI-object visibility off/on works in the initial HUD interval.
sites.limits: Only the initial local hide/re-show interval is accepted; later/final ordinary HUD restoration is not established.

frames.reviewer_observation: Ordinary HUD is visible: bottom-left boost/flame and x2, lower-right River City map and labels. No debug speed text, 4:3 frame or SatNav outline.
Ordinary boost/flame/x2 and lower-right map/labels disappear; world/car and independent diagnostic overlays remain.
Boost/flame/x2 and lower-right map/labels reappear locally.

sites.caption: Toggle MiniMap Visibility
sites.bounded_claim: MiniMap callback hides and re-shows map tile/icons.
sites.limits: Read-only row 0015 corroborates this callback and gets no separate credit; header/miles text need not disappear.

frames.reviewer_observation: Boost/flame/x2 and lower-right map/labels reappear locally.
The map tile/icons disappear while River City header and miles-driven text remain.
Map tile/icons reappear in the same lower-right HUD region.

sites.caption: Speedo Visibility:
sites.bounded_claim: Debug SPEED/RPM/GEAR text is visible when enabled and absent after disable.
sites.limits: Only stationary displayed values 0 mph/1000 RPM/gear 1 are observed; data accuracy and ordinary-HUD loss are not certified.

frames.reviewer_observation: Map tile/icons reappear in the same lower-right HUD region.
Upper-left SPEED:0mph, RPM:1000, GEAR:1 text appears. Ordinary boost/map HUD is now absent; cause is not established.
The three upper-left speed/RPM/gear lines disappear. Ordinary HUD remains absent.

sites.caption: Show/Hide 4:3 Area
sites.bounded_claim: F4 callback produces a green central 4:3 frame and removes it on the second call.
sites.limits: Callback-only flag has no alias readback; scoped key/script bindings, source toggle and direct image contrast provide the evidence.

frames.reviewer_observation: The three upper-left speed/RPM/gear lines disappear. Ordinary HUD remains absent.
A green central 4:3 rectangular frame appears, spanning the image height.
Green 4:3 frame is absent again; ordinary HUD remains absent.

sites.limits: Visibility only; clipped/overlapping rows and numeric counts are not certified.
